defects.claim_says: the national emergency it declares was continued by the notice of March 24, 2026 (91 FR 15515)
defects.source_says: EO 14071 declares no national emergency; its preamble takes additional steps with respect to the emergency declared in EO 14024 of April 15, 2021, as expanded by EO 14066. The legal basis misattributes the emergency and contradicts the claim's own rationale.
The continuation notices (FR Docs 2022-08244, 2023-07702, 2024-07817, 2025-06399, 2026-06078) are Presidential notices; an actor placeholder is not an actor.

22 U.S.C. 10802(d) (Pub. L. 119-111, div. A, title I, sec. 102, Sept. 18, 2026; held at jobs/theophilus-sources/output/texts/usc-t22-s10802.txt) keeps in effect the sanctions and other measures under any Executive Order issued to address the emergency continued on March 24, 2026 (the EO 14024 emergency), as in effect on September 17, 2026; EO 14071 is such an order and the claim omits this legislative event before the cutoff.
